title.zh: 授权菲律宾体育记者协会每年举办一场慈善拳击表演赛，其净收益设立为残疾菲律宾拳击手利益信托基金的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Philippine Sportswriters Association to Hold One Benefit Boxing Show Every Year, the Net Proceeds of Which Shall Constitute a Trust Fund for the Benefit of Disabled Filipino Boxers
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Philippine Sportswriters Association to Hold One Benefit Boxing Show Every Year, the Net Proceeds of Which Shall Constitute a Trust Fund for the Benefit of Disabled Filipino Boxers
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Philippine Sportswriters Association tổ chức một buổi biểu diễn quyền Anh gây quỹ mỗi năm để lập quỹ tín thác hỗ trợ võ sĩ quyền Anh Philippines khuyết tật
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้ Philippine Sportswriters Association จัดการแข่งขันชกมวยการกุศลปีละครั้งเพื่อนำรายได้สุทธิเข้ากองทุนทรัสต์ช่วยเหลือนักมวยฟิลิปปินส์พิการ
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengizinkan Philippine Sportswriters Association mengadakan pertunjukan tinju amal setiap tahun untuk membentuk dana perwalian bagi petinju Filipina penyandang disabilitas
title.ms: Akta yang membenarkan Philippine Sportswriters Association mengadakan pertunjukan tinju amal setiap tahun untuk membentuk dana amanah bagi peninju Filipina kurang upaya

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1373_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The Philippine Sportswriters Association is authorized to hold one benefit boxing show every year, the net proceeds of which shall be for the benefit of disabled Filipino boxers.
The benefit boxing shows promoted by the Philippine Sportswriters Association pursuant to the provisions of this Act shall be exempt from all taxes.

The net proceeds of the benefit boxing shows shall constitute a trust fund to be known as the "Disabled Filipino Boxers Trust Fund" and shall be administered by a Board of Trustees, composed of the Chairman of the Games and Amusements Board, as chairman, and a representative of the Philippine Sportswriters Association and of the Philippine Boxing Association, as members.
Subject to the rules and regulations as the Board of Trustees may from time to time promulgate, the trust fund shall be available for the benefit of poor and deserving disabled Filipino boxers.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1955.
